[[File:Maya DP154.png|thumb|250px|Maya]] '''Maya''' (Japanese: '''マヨ''' ''Mayo'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP154|Mastering Current Events!]]''. She is the granddaughter and student of [[McCann]]. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} ran into Maya and while her {{p|Chimecho}} battled McCann's {{p|Scizor}}. The battle ended with McCann's victory. Her cheery nature softened McCann's hardened stance against all {{pkmn|Trainer}}s who he viewed as unworthy of his training. With little effort, she convinced her grandfather to have a {{pkmn|battle}} with Ash and have a rematch the following day. As Ash and his friends left [[Ash's Gliscor]] in their hands, she reassured him that it would be looked after. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Maya |pkmn=Chimecho |type1=Psychic |img=Maya Chimecho.png |epnum=DP154 |epname=Mastering Current Events! |vaen= |vajp=Satsuki Yukino |desc={{p|Chimecho}} is Maya's only known Pokémon. Like her grandfather's Scizor, Maya's Chimecho also used winds to fly and was used by Maya against her grandfather in battle. Although Chimecho was powerful, it was unable to stand up to Scizor's skill in the air and was defeated, accidentally knocking {{TP|Dawn|Piplup}} out in the process. Chimecho's only known move is {{m|Psywave}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{psychic color}}|bordercolor={{psychic color light}} |ja=三ツ木勇気 ''Yūki Mitsugi'' |en=[[Amy Palant]] |fi=Ella Pyhältö |fr_eu=Béatrice Wegnez |it=Serena Clerici |es_eu=Belén Rodríguez |pt_br=Priscila Ferreira |cs=Jana Páleníčková}} ==Trivia== * She shares her dub name with {{an|Dawn}}'s {{pmin|Spain|Iberian Spanish}} name. Coincidentally, in the Iberian Spanish dub she was named May, which is the English name of {{an|May|another main character}}. {{-}}
